summary: Daily plain compressed Postgres snapshot. Desktop tag. 07:50 Europe/London.
description: SSH-bridge wrapper. Runs postgres-snapshot.ps1 -Plain -Execute -OneDriveCopy into C:\Users\lndco\antiphon-backups and copies the verified plain dump into OneDrive\Backups\antiphon-postgres. The dump is unencrypted and syncs to the cloud because the operator asked for that folder on 2026-11-10. Age encryption stays the default of the script; this job names -Plain. The schedule is enabled because the operator asked for the daily job.
content:
#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
ssh -i /tmp/windmill/worker_to_windows -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o BatchMode=yes lndco@host.docker.internal "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Users\lndco\antiphon-snapshot-runner\invoke-postgres-snapshot.ps1"
exit $?
